lines: Each time the things I cannot do increase
I measured the worth of my life
Whenever the self I want to become fades
I lose sight of the right path
Then it's fine if what remains ahead is darkness
It's better than dying here now
That's right
Alas, I no longer harbor any expectations now
There is no way
The back of a bird soaring through the distant sky
looked freer than anything
was nothing but one of countless specks of dust
yet I was undeniably born into this world
to obtain something unknown
I trampled the flowers at my feet
Each time unseen wounds heal
the moon, the ultramarine, the past recede into the distance
Even if only goodbye remains in life
Hey, meeting you must have meaning, right?
than that unchangeable time
the future I have yet to see
words I erased and wrote over countless times
Hey, is there no value in things that can't be sold?
even if I'm anyone's counterfeit
I also want to see at least one dream
the endless sound, the words
Now, carve the proof that I am alive
wishes, dreams, and hopes without shade or sun
they may not come true, yet
to lack is to take away
is filled with ugliness
Alas
Hey, if I could go somewhere far away just like this
at least let me scatter beautifully
the burning starfire in the distant sky
shone brighter than anything
If I had never met you
I would have lived in a cage that pretended to be the world
chasing the single sliver of light that pierced through
